title: Slim in the studio and his records
summary: Cotton says Ray Charles played on The Things I Used to Do; Slim was demanding in the studio, and the band didn't note where they recorded.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: it for a while, but after that, I'm ready to come back here. Back south.
Well, any other stories about Slim? Because everybody would do... Did you... You weren't on the things I used to do. You weren't on that...
No, no, no, no. I was Ray Charles.
I was Ray Charles on that.
Yeah, it took him a couple of days to make that record.
Yeah, it took him a couple of days to make that record. That's why...
